# Use clawmain plugins from any marketplace

The simplest route: `/plugin marketplace add vishnu-77/clawmain`.

To list a clawmain plugin inside **your own** marketplace, add an entry with a `git-subdir` source. Claude Code sparse-clones only that plugin's folder. Pin `ref` to a tag (or add `sha`) for reproducible installs.

```json
{
  "plugins": [
    {
      "name": "groundwork",
      "source": {
        "source": "git-subdir",
        "url": "https://github.com/vishnu-77/clawmain.git",
        "path": "plugins/groundwork",
        "ref": "main"
      },
      "description": "Guided Claude Code setup with why-tag lessons."
    },
    {
      "name": "agent-ops",
      "source": {
        "source": "git-subdir",
        "url": "https://github.com/vishnu-77/clawmain.git",
        "path": "plugins/agent-ops",
        "ref": "main"
      },
      "description": "Run agents as a disciplined loop: plan, verify, reflect, budget, route handoffs, and learn from failures."
    },
    {
      "name": "ai-engineering",
      "source": {
        "source": "git-subdir",
        "url": "https://github.com/vishnu-77/clawmain.git",
        "path": "plugins/ai-engineering",
        "ref": "main"
      },
      "description": "Build LLM-powered product features that hold up: evals, prompts, RAG, tool schemas, guardrails, cost, and context design."
    },
    {
      "name": "architecture",
      "source": {
        "source": "git-subdir",
        "url": "https://github.com/vishnu-77/clawmain.git",

      },
```
